op.description: ls = list, get = show one, add = add one, rm = remove one, reset = undo all your changes

name.description: get, rm: the tool name (or its path). add: the name to call it by (default: the folder name)

path.description: add: the tool folder, JSON file or executable; relative paths start at your workspace

path_json.description: add, instead of path: a directive kept as written and looked up on every use, like {"$env": "AOS_HOME", "$path": "/lib/base/math"}

replace.description: add: true replaces a tool you already have with the same name

envs.description: add: fixed environment values for every call of this tool, like {"AOS_MEMORY": "/data/memory"}; stored as written, not for secrets

env_file.description: add: a file of KEY=VALUE lines read on every call (for secrets); relative paths start at your workspace

no_cache.description: add: for an executable tool, ask it for its definition every time

long.description: ls: true = one text line per tool with where it comes from, including tools you turned off (null)
